name: Busa Retail Intel
description: Daily industry-intelligence cockpit for retail stores and consumer brands: source-backed signals, buyer-intent interpretation, approved sales/merchandising actions, and channel drafts (staff brief / IG story / store sign) for review before any external handoff. Signals/actions/drafts enter Busabase only through the agent's own browsing-and-writing workflow (see SKILL.md); the AirApp itself is read/decision-only.

agentPrompts.label: Give me today's cockpit overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-retail-intel` skill in this folder, then give me today's overview: needs-review / approved / blocked counts, top signals, and the actions ready to go.

agentPrompts.label: Collect today's batch
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-retail-intel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then browse today's configured sources, build one narrow buyer scene, and write the new signal/action/draft rows into Busabase tied to evidence — mark anything without solid evidence `blocked` instead of guessing.

agentPrompts.label: Carry out my approved items
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-retail-intel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run `execute_decisions.mjs` (dry-run) to list the concrete operation for every decided signal/action/draft, and after I confirm and any real handoff happens outside this app, run `execute_decisions.mjs --apply` to mark the approved items done.
